actions: Health monitor: rewritten to read Thanos (firing alerts + down targets), schedule restored, single-issue lifecycle. Merged #157. Tested: 2 branch dispatches, then merged; issue #156 created and verified.

Deploy/rollback (Path A): Vault AppRole github-runner + least-privilege policy (read secret/homelab/portainer only). Merged #159, applied with -target (drift left for separate decision), role_id + secret_id stored as GitHub secrets VAULT_ROLE_ID/VAULT_SECRET_ID.

Deploy/rollback workflows: dockermaster-deployment.yml -> portainer-deploy.yml, emergency-rollback.yml -> portainer-rollback.yml, both via scripts/ci/portainer-cli.sh with dry-run default. Merged #160.

Tests: AppRole login verified (token 95 chars, TTL 899s; read portainer secret 200; list other metadata 403). portainer-cli.sh list shows ~80 live stacks. Deploy dry-run (grafana) passed; one real grafana redeploy failed once on a transient 30s timeout, then succeeded ("redeployed grafana id=147"). Rollback dry-run passed.
limits: True version rollback remains git revert + terraform apply (not a GitHub button).
The Vault state drift (16 import + 3 change) was NOT applied.
deploy.yml (legacy webhook/ssh deploy) still exists and is out of scope.
